sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Attention is a Mental skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Attention increases the looting speed of various containers.

sections.heading: Hideout
sections.text:
- Level 3 of this skill is needed for the Intelligence Center level 2
- Level 3 of this skill is needed for the Water Collector level 2

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases looting speed (2% per level → +100% at Elite Level)
- Increases item examination speed speed (2% per level → +100% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Doubles your looting EXP
- Elite level: Chance to instantly find an item in a container (+50%)

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Picking up loose loot
- Uncovering loot in Loot containers (0.08 skill points per item)
- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
